[size=3]Hello, this is my first official recolor mod, I am very new to public showing mods, normally I make only for personal use. I have used DustBeauty's DIY recolors and changed tiles to work with 1.6.[/size]

[url=https://emojipedia.org/crescent-moon]🌙[/url][url=https://emojipedia.org/crescent-moon]🌙[/url]

[size=3]No longer will there be such a sharp shift in terrain and foliage when season changing, you will begin to see snow on the grass at the end of fall, and spring will slowly become more green as summer approaches.[/size]

[size=3][b]Now including brand new trees, grass, bushes, replacing just about everything in the game with slow seasonal changes.[/b] You can use any plants with this mod but recommended to turn winter snow blue into grey to match best.

The Rustic version will not look very good with foliage redone, but there are plenty of other foliage mods on nexus to try, it should look fine with vanilla as well.[/size]

[size=3]Highly HIGHLY recommend using [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13767]Winter Rain[/url]﻿[size=3] and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/486]Snow Fall 28th[/url]﻿[size=3] mods for more immersion.
also for new saves try [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13225][size=3]Random Start Day[/size][/url]﻿﻿

[size=3]This mod is very low priority so it should not override any other mod other than vanilla. Please be gentle with criticism or issue I have high anxiety and difficulty bein﻿g social. ^^

this mod should match with most building recolors just pick the eemie or foliageredone options

to change between the configurations easily please use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿

[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/24rgoBV.png[/img]

[size=3]It is made to go with toned down colors and non-blue snow, [/size][b]it is recommended to use the included foliage
[/b]Optional Green Fall as well
